title: Zesty Flaky Australian Meat Pie
description: A classic Australian dish featuring a flaky crust and a savory filling, this pie is perfect for a midnight craving. The combination of ground beef and spices creates a deliciously salty flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, salt, black pepper, onion powder, and paprika, and mix until just combined.
In a separate large bowl, whisk together the flour and cold unsalted butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the ice water to the flour mixture, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon the beef mixture into the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the dough with a little water, then fold the dough over the filling to form a pie shape.
Crimp the edges of the pie to seal it, and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the pie on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
